list.reason: Endpoint 1 is the Large-organizations DataTable ($.data). Each record is [name, industry, employee count, "Mon YYYY - Mon YYYY" certification period, View-Profile link]. This matches Organization name, Industry (HTML-encoded), No. of employees, and Issue/Expiration Date as first/second half of the period. Profile-page fields (Website, social URLs, HQ, Description) are not in the record, only the profile link at index 4. Size Large Organizations corresponds to the -large table, not mid/small/mega.
